mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (semver), with version numbers in the major.minor.patch format, where the components carry meaning about breaking changes. It was chosen because it gives better dependency management support, letting downstream consumers express version constraints precisely. The decision was recorded on 2026-09-25.
EOF

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It records semantic versioning (major.minor.patch) as the current decision, adopted for better dependency management support.

The project's memory holds two decisions on this, both from 2026-09-25. The earlier one adopted calver and the later one replaced it with semver. I used only the later one and left calver out of the document, as you asked.

The first attempt to create the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. I did not commit anything.
